verdict.rationale: Langfuse does not version automations as such. What it offers is prompt management: prompts are versioned and promoted through labels across environments, and new versions can be reviewed through experiments, side-by-side comparison, and CI/CD regression gates. This covers versioning and review only for prompts, not for broader automations such as evaluators, alerts, or workflows. Rollback is implied by moving labels between versions but is never documented explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit rollback documentation, versioning of non-prompt automations, and independent hands-on corroboration (one community comment calls the prompt management feature set lagging).
